findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "upload_video" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guide, contents, feedback_list, feedback_get, wait_for_feedback, get_annotated_frames, get_frame, asset_status, permission_get, search, recent_activity, folder_create, items_update · Private data: asset_status, upload_video, upload_file_start, upload_file_complete, version_notes_get, version_notes_update, version_file_upload · Public sink: feedback_post, asset_status, tags, upload_video, upload_file_start, upload_file_complete, folder_create, items_update, versions_update, version_notes_update, version_file_upload · Destructive: upload_file_start, versions_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guide, contents, feedback_list, feedback_get, wait_for_feedback, get_annotated_frames, get_frame, asset_status, permission_get, search, recent_activity, folder_create, items_update · Private data: asset_status, upload_video, upload_file_start, upload_file_complete, version_notes_get, version_notes_update, version_file_upload · Public sink: feedback_post, asset_status, tags, upload_video, upload_file_start, upload_file_complete, folder_create, items_update, versions_update, version_notes_update, version_file_upload · Destructive: upload_file_start, versions_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
